description: Sends one message, in the person's own words, into a conversation they already have with somebody they connected with at an event. Needs a personal connector token (a shared token reads and sends nothing), `text`, and the conversation as `firstName` (as event_inbox spelled it) or `chatId` (as event_inbox returned it). The message is delivered when the call returns and cannot be unsent. It sends as that person into their own conversation only; the server checks this on every call and refuses with NOT_PARTICIPANT otherwise. A `firstName` that matches two of their conversations returns AMBIGUOUS_NAME and sends nothing. The app's own cooldown, flood limit and content rules apply, because it is the same send; RATE_LIMITED means messages are going out too fast. Returns ok:true when sent, which says nothing about whether the other person has read it or will reply.

chatId.description: Optional. The id of the conversation, as an event_inbox thread row gave it. When both this and firstName are sent, this one is used.

firstName.description: Optional. The first name of the person to answer, as an event_inbox thread row spelled it, matched against the caller's own conversations only. Two matches return AMBIGUOUS_NAME and nothing is sent.

text.description: The message in the person's own words, up to 1000 characters. It is sent as given.

name: event_reply
title: Reply to a message
